context: Two cafe friends share a heartfelt moment
purpose: Teach: 痛感/がんばり/おっさん/まいっ/たまらない/心地よい/思いやり/きみ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、自分のがんばり、痛感する場面が多くて。
lines.en: Lately I've been noticing my own efforts more and more—it's hitting me harder.
lines.style: Soft, vulnerable opening. Introspective pace. Slight breathiness on the self-realization. Trailing off slightly, like she's surprised by her own honesty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まいったね。でも、きみは自分にもっと思いやり持っていいよ。
lines.en: That sounds exhausting. But you know, you could afford to be gentler with yourself too.
lines.style: Warm and knowing. Slight lean-in, like she's speaking from experience. Not lecturing—offering. Gentle firmness on 'gentler.' Steady, kind eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 隣のおっさんが、急に話しかけてくる時もたまらないけどね。
lines.en: Though honestly, when that guy sitting next to me suddenly starts talking, that's pretty unbearable too.
lines.style: Dry, almost-laughing tone. Light and sharp. Self-aware humor cutting through the seriousness. Quickens slightly on the complaint, then lets it float away.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ふふ、心地よいって思えない時もある。
lines.en: Hehe—yeah, sometimes you can't really call that pleasant, can you.
lines.style: Knowing, conspiratorial laugh. Quiet warmth. Matching her tone. Short and genuine. Slight shared-secret quality—they both understand.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。でも、今日のラテはまさに心地よい味だった。
lines.en: Mmhm. But today's latte—that was actually genuinely pleasant.
lines.style: Softening, small smile in the voice. Warm recognition. Slight emphasis on 'genuinely' like she's savoring the word. Open, grateful tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Quiet warmth. Brief and sincere. No performance. The care underneath clear and simple. Soft close.
